sources.title: Owner-requested school enhancement
sources.note: No separate high-school image was supplied. Conservative edge planting, open lawns, paths and schematic parking fit the complete saved OSM grounds, two standing classroom roofs and full adjacent road/path widths; placement is estimated from mapped geometry and the owner request. Undated draft estimates; no surveyed boundary, species, court markings, construction date, roof reconstruction or vehicle inventory inferred. Reference bitmap remains ignored evidence.
